title: Personal assistants and companions
short: An assistant that knows the user's life, plans and preferences from the first message.
description: Build a personal assistant or AI companion that remembers the user across conversations with Recall: model, code in TypeScript and Python, settings, cost and forgetting.

title: Customer support
short: Agents and bots that know each customer's history across tickets and channels.
description: Give a support bot and human agents memory of each customer across tickets, chat and email with Recall: model, code, handoffs, deletion requests and cost.

title: Coding agents
short: Claude Code, Codex and your own agents that remember conventions and decisions.
description: Give coding agents memory of a developer's preferences, a project's conventions and past decisions with Recall: plugins, MCP, code, settings and cost.

title: Game NPCs
short: Characters that remember the player, keep their own point of view and gossip.
description: Build game NPCs that remember the player with Recall: one memory per save, each NPC's own point of view, fast context for dialogue, code in TypeScript and Python, C# for Unity, cost and speed.

title: Sales and CRM copilots
short: A copilot that remembers every prospect, call and objection across the deal.
description: Build a sales copilot that remembers prospects, calls and objections across a deal with Recall: accounts as scopes, call notes, meeting prep, code and cost.

title: Multi-agent systems
short: Agents that share what they learn, each with its own view and its own key.
description: Share memory between agents with Recall: agents as peers, private and shared views, scoped keys per agent, webhooks to react to new knowledge, code and cost.

title: Tutoring and education
short: A tutor that tracks what each learner knows, mixes up and is working towards.
description: Build a tutor that remembers each learner's progress, misconceptions and goals with Recall: model, structured answers, code, care for minors' data, cost.

title: Discord and Slack bots
short: A bot in a busy channel that keeps every member apart and remembers each one.
description: Build a Discord or Slack bot that remembers every member of a busy channel with Recall: channels as sessions, members as peers, per-member memory, code and cost.

title: Health, fitness and coaching
short: A coach that remembers goals, setbacks and what worked, handled with care.
description: Build a coaching or wellness assistant that remembers goals, progress and setbacks with Recall: model, code, sensitive data, consent and deletion, cost.

title: Voice agents
short: Phone and voice assistants that know the caller, within a real-time budget.
description: Give a voice or phone agent memory of the caller with Recall within a real-time latency budget: context before the call, one call per turn, code, measured speed and cost.

title: Shopping assistants
short: Recommendations that remember sizes, tastes, budgets and what was returned.
description: Build a shopping assistant that remembers sizes, tastes, budgets and returns with Recall: structured preferences, code, consent and cost.

title: Workplace assistants
short: An assistant for a team that remembers projects, decisions and who owns what.
description: Build a workplace assistant that remembers a team's projects, decisions and owners with Recall: projects as scopes, scoped keys, imports, code and cost.

title: Designing workspaces, peers and sessions
short: How to map your product onto Recall so memory stays separate where it should.
description: How to map a product onto Recall's workspaces, peers, sessions and scopes, who observes whom, and the mistakes that mix up memories.

title: Reasoning levels and models
short: When to read context, when to ask, and which reasoning level to pick.
description: Choose between prompt context, search and chat, pick a reasoning level per question, and what models Recall answers with, from our own measurements.

title: Privacy, consent and forgetting
short: What to store, how to tell users, and how to forget a person completely.
description: Privacy with Recall: what to store and what not, consent, opting people out of being modelled, scoped keys, EU hosting, export and forgetting a person.

title: Cost and speed
short: What a user costs per month and how fast each call is, with the arithmetic.
description: Estimate what Recall costs per user per month and how fast each call is, with worked examples, measured latencies and ways to spend less.
